thread:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — finalizing launch readiness for PRD v2. Need SLOs, acceptance criteria, and graceful-degrade spec by EOD Thurs. Focus: hosted API + Dedicated parity on latency budgets.

Matt (SRE): Quick Q: Do we set a single 99th latency budget for both hosted/dedicated? Customers expect dedicated to be stricter.

Elaine (PM): Preferred: tiered SLOs. Hosted: p50 60ms, p95 220ms, p99 600ms; Dedicated: p50 40ms, p95 140ms, p99 400ms. Error budget allocation: hosted 1.5%/month, dedicated 0.5%/month. Thoughts?

Sanjay (Eng Platform): Numbers look reasonable, but we need to call out tail-latency regression detection + automated fallback. Proposal: automatic model-fallback to a smaller quantized variant after an extra 300ms queuing threshold.

Katie (Product Ops): From pilots: enterprise customers want SLA with penalty for dedicated if p99 > 1s more than 3 incidents/month. Legal needs exact thresholds — flagging.

Matt (SRE): Operational note: we can't promise identical p95 across regions at launch. Add a region-level SLO opt-out and a 'best-effort replication' flag in the PRD.

Ruth (Eng-ML): For acceptance tests: perf-run with 1k concurrent requests, 90/10 length distribution, measure latency histogram and 10% tail. We'll assert no regression >15% on p99 vs baseline.

Elaine (PM): Draft acceptance checklist:
```
- [ ] SLO definitions documented for hosted and dedicated (p50/p95/p99 + error budget)
- [ ] Canary deploy validates latency + error budget against baseline (automated)
- [ ] Graceful-degrade path works: smaller model fallback + structured partial response
- [ ] Rollback policy: auto-fallback if error spike >0.5% over 5m AND p99 > threshold
- [ ] Observability: metrics (latency histogram, errors, queue depth), dashboards, alert runbooks
- [ ] SLA wording drafted for legal and pilot customers
- [ ] Perf harness run + artifacts uploaded
```

Ops Bot: Deploy bot report: canary baseline shows 0.8% errors at 10k qps for model-x-q3-quant1; flagging for investigation.

Sanjay (Eng Platform): Add explicit rollback window in PRD: immediate fallback + investigation window 30m, then scoped retry. Also include a config knob `slo.enforced=false` for region rollouts.

Matt (SRE): :thumbsup: Also add 'graceful degrade' response format: return `{"partial":true, "reason":"latency_shed", "retry_after_ms":...}` and fall back to streaming when full gen isn't available.

Elaine (PM): OK — I'll update PRD with tiered SLOs, acceptance checklist, rollback rules, and customer SLA draft. Owners: SLOs -> Matt; Rollback/runtime -> Sanjay; Tests -> Ruth; Legal/customer SLA -> Katie. Deadline: Thu 5pm PT.

Katie (Product Ops): Noted. I'll loop in Legal + pilot contacts for SLA wording.

Ruth (Eng-ML): I'll schedule perf-harness runs Tue and post results here.
